authority: Curated mapping from the Texas AI Governance controls (TRAIGA HB 149 + SB 1964) to the Crystal Warden AI-GOV controls, which are themselves NIST AI RMF-structured (see ai_governance__nist_ai_rmf). Chaining texas_ai -> ai_governance -> nist_ai_rmf establishes and evidences the TRAIGA safe-harbor posture (adoption of a recognized standard). Mappings are curated and should be verified; a target control is considered supporting evidence, not automatic satisfaction. Disclosure controls (TX-DISC) have no direct AI-GOV analog and map only partially. Fail-closed: a Texas control is not treated as met merely because a mapped AI-GOV control is met.
